_readme: Translate the VALUES of en.json only; never change a key. Keep every {placeholder}, HTML tag and attribute exactly as written (translate only the text between tags). Never translate: the brand "The Cute Devil" / "the cute devil", product names, "Grand Minds Technology", "WhatsApp", "LinkedIn", the phone number, order references (TCD-…) and the text inside [SQUARE BRACKETS] (owner placeholders). Voice: charming, intriguing, a little mysterious; short sentences. Do not use words meaning trouble, bad, sin or naughty. Headlines, buttons, labels and badges are lowercase in English on purpose: keep them lowercase where your script has case. Plurals: keys ending in .one / .other are plural forms; if your language needs more forms add sibling keys with the same stem ending in .zero, .two, .few or .many (CLDR categories), each containing {n}.

order.hero.shipped: Headline, lowercase on purpose. Keep it short. Order shipped. Keep the <span>.
order.hero.delivered: Headline, lowercase on purpose. Keep it short. Order delivered. Keep the <span>.
order.lede.cod: Under the headline, for cash on delivery.
order.lede.delivered: Under the headline. Brand voice: a light wink.
order.confirming.title: Headline, lowercase on purpose. Keep it short.
order.pending.title: Headline, lowercase on purpose. Keep it short.
order.pending.cta: Button label. Lowercase, short (about 24 characters at most).
order.waiting.title: Headline, lowercase on purpose. Keep it short.
order.waiting.cta: Button label. Lowercase, short (about 24 characters at most).
order.failed.title: Headline, lowercase on purpose. Keep it short.
order.failed.cta: Button label. Lowercase, short (about 24 characters at most).
order.cancelled.title: Headline, lowercase on purpose. Keep it short.
order.notFound.title: Headline, lowercase on purpose. Keep it short.
order.error.title: Headline, lowercase on purpose. Keep it short.
order.step.paid: Step 1 of the delivery timeline. Lowercase, one word.
order.step.confirmed: Step 1 of the timeline for cash on delivery. Lowercase, one word.
order.step.production: Step 2 of the delivery timeline. Lowercase.
order.step.shipped: Step 3 of the delivery timeline. Lowercase, one word.
order.step.delivered: Step 4 of the delivery timeline. Lowercase, one word.
order.step.now: Small text under the current step of the timeline. Lowercase.
order.step.srDone: Screen-reader only, after a finished step.
order.step.srNow: Screen-reader only, after the current step.
order.step.srNext: Screen-reader only, after a step that has not started.
order.parcels.titleOne: Section title when the order travels in one parcel. Lowercase.
order.parcels.title.one: Plural form (one). {n} = number of parcels. Lowercase.
order.parcels.title.other: Plural form (other). Section title when the order travels in several parcels. {n} = number. Lowercase.
order.parcels.split: Plain explanation above the list of parcels.
order.parcel.single: Card title when there is one parcel. Lowercase.
order.tracking.label: Before the carrier name and tracking number.
order.tracking.cta: Button label. Lowercase, short (about 24 characters at most).
order.summary.title: Title of the summary card on the order page. Lowercase.
order.facts.shipTo: Row label before the city and country. Lowercase.
order.payment.unpaid: Payment state on the order page. Lowercase, short.
order.payment.paid: Payment state on the order page. Lowercase, short.
order.payment.refund_pending: Payment state on the order page. Lowercase, short.
order.payment.refunded: Payment state on the order page. Lowercase, short.
order.payment.partially_refunded: Payment state on the order page. Lowercase, short.
order.payment.cod_due: Payment state on the order page. Lowercase, short.
order.payment.cod_collected: Payment state on the order page. Lowercase, short.
order.help.title: Headline, lowercase on purpose. Keep it short.
order.help.cta: Button label. Lowercase, short (about 24 characters at most).
orderStatus.pending_payment: Order status badge. Lowercase, one to three words.
orderStatus.confirmed: Order status badge. Lowercase, one to three words.
orderStatus.processing: Order status badge. Lowercase, one to three words.
orderStatus.partially_shipped: Order status badge. Lowercase, one to three words.
orderStatus.shipped: Order status badge. Lowercase, one to three words.

orderStatus.expired: Order status badge. Lowercase, one to three words.

fulfilmentStatus.submitted: State of one parcel. Status badge. Lowercase, one to three words.
fulfilmentStatus.in_production: State of one parcel. Status badge. Lowercase, one to three words.

email.common.greeting: E-mail to the customer. First line. {name} = customer name.
email.common.orderNumber: E-mail to the customer. {id} = order number (TCD-…).
email.common.viewOrder: E-mail to the customer. Button that opens the order status page.
email.common.items: E-mail to the customer. Heading above the list of products.
email.common.subtotal: E-mail to the customer. Row label.
email.common.shipping: E-mail to the customer. Row label.
email.common.tax: E-mail to the customer. Row label.
email.common.taxIncluded: E-mail to the customer. {amount} = formatted price.
email.common.total: E-mail to the customer. Row label.
email.common.paymentMethod: E-mail to the customer. Row label.
email.common.help: E-mail to the customer. {whatsapp} = phone number or link. Keep "WhatsApp".
email.common.signature: E-mail to the customer. Sign-off. Never translated: copy as it is.
email.common.footer: E-mail to the customer. Small print. {site} = website address.
email.order_confirmed.subject: E-mail to the customer. Subject line. {id} = order number.
email.order_confirmed.intro: E-mail to the customer. First paragraph (paid by card).
email.order_confirmed.introCod: E-mail to the customer. First paragraph (cash on delivery).
email.order_confirmed.next: E-mail to the customer. Second paragraph.
email.order_confirmed.split: E-mail to the customer. Shown when the order ships in more than one parcel.
email.order_confirmed.madeToOrder: E-mail to the customer. Legal reminder for personalised pieces. Keep the meaning exact.
email.shipped.subject: E-mail to the customer. Subject line. {id} = order number.
email.shipped.intro: E-mail to the customer. First paragraph.
email.shipped.tracking: E-mail to the customer. {carrier} = courier name, {number} = tracking number.
email.shipped.track: E-mail to the customer. Button that opens the courier tracking page.
email.shipped.more: E-mail to the customer. Shown when other parcels are still to ship.
email.order_cancelled.subject: E-mail to the customer. Subject line. {id} = order number.
email.order_cancelled.intro: E-mail to the customer. First paragraph.
email.refund_issued.subject: E-mail to the customer. Subject line. {id} = order number.
email.refund_issued.intro: E-mail to the customer. {amount} = formatted price.
apiError.ORDER_CLOSED: Error message shown to the customer at checkout when an old, unpaid checkout attempt has expired on the server. One or two short, calm sentences.
checkout.notServed.hint: Small hint under the country select at checkout. A WhatsApp button follows it.
checkout.notServed.text: Notice under the country select when the visitor seems to be in a country we do not deliver to online yet (for example the United Arab Emirates). {country} = country name in the reader's language. Calm, not an error.
cart.notServed: Short note in the bag under the delivery-country select. {country} = country name. One or two short sentences.
shop.on.meta.description: Search-engine description of the shop page when online checkout is on. About 150 characters.
product.on.meta.description: Search-engine description of a product page when online checkout is on. About 150 characters.
home.on.how.word3: Third word of the home headline "pick. add. pay. done." when online checkout is on. One lowercase word with a full stop.
home.on.how.name3: Name of step 3 on the home page when online checkout is on. One lowercase word.
home.on.how.text3: Text of step 3 on the home page when online checkout is on. One short sentence.
home.on.how.text4: Text of step 4 on the home page when online checkout is on. One short sentence.
story.on.values.text4: Story page, fourth value, when online checkout is on. Two short sentences.
faq.on.meta.description: Search-engine description of the FAQ page when online checkout is on. About 150 characters.
faq.on.howOrderingWorks.a1: FAQ answer (first paragraph) to "How does ordering work?" when online checkout is on.
faq.on.howOrderingWorks.a2: FAQ answer (second paragraph) to "How does ordering work?" when online checkout is on.
faq.on.whyWhatsapp.q: FAQ question when online checkout is on (replaces "Why do you use WhatsApp?").
faq.on.whyWhatsapp.a1: FAQ answer. The quoted words are the button label of key cart.whatsappInstead: use your translation of that key.
faq.on.arePricesFinal.a: FAQ answer to "Are the prices final?" when online checkout is on.
faq.on.payment.a1: FAQ answer to "How do I pay?" when online checkout is on. Plain text, no HTML.
faq.on.delivery.a1: FAQ answer to "Where do you deliver?" when online checkout is on. Keep the <a> tag and its attributes unchanged. “deliver to” is the footer label of key footer.country: use your translation of that key.
home.on.how.note: Small note under the home page steps when online checkout is on. One short sentence.
